maintenance.codeHome: PC-AI is executor authority; fleet atlas and agent-bus are optional observers, not runtime prerequisites
maintenance.secrets: Private keys, bearer tokens and raw credentials never belong in this registry or release ZIP
maintenance.portChanges: Rediscover enrolled physical identity at runtime; ifIndex and alias are observations. Changed adapter GUID/MAC or controller UUID requires reviewed custody migration, not state deletion or broad trust.
maintenance.release: Build from committed registry/payload bytes with usb4_fleet_release.py; ship exact hashes and retain installed revisions/preimages. Templates-only is not an executable Linux/macOS release.
maintenance.scope: No default route, DNS, NFS, VLAN, VPN or hardware reset follows merely from inventory or packaging.
